title: Receipt
description: A signed receipt proving that a given prompt produced a given output on a given model at a given time. Prompt and output are hashed, not stored. Encodings match the Receipt primitive in SPEC.md.

receipt_id.description: Unique per completion. Lowercase canonical UUID string (RFC 4122).

prompt_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonicalized request body, lowercase hex, prefixed "sha256:".

output_hash.description: SHA-256 of the full response body, lowercase hex, prefixed "sha256:".

issued_at.description: Issuance time as an RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

key_id.description: Identifier of the public key used for verification; resolved against the published key set.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature (64 raw bytes) over the canonical signing input, base64url-encoded without padding.
